simple.meaning: an appellation , as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor , authority , character
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שֵׁם (H8034) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 864 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שֵׁם (shêm) means an appellation , as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor , authority , character First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 19.
